eventLock.doc: The same IOLock held while native notification detaches pending waiters.

pendingHead.doc: Head of the native pending waiter queue.

pendingTail.doc: Pointer to the last next field in the native pending waiter queue.

waiterNext.doc: Intrusive next pointer reused by the native listener only after event dequeue.

waiterPrevious.doc: Pointer to the preceding next field.

lookup.doc: Retained event resolved from a Mach send right in the caller task.

value.doc: Acquire-load of the full 64-bit shared value.

signal.doc: Monotonic value update and native listener notification.

listener_create.doc: Retained asynchronous native listener; argument zero selects the default high-priority notification service.

waiter_create.doc: Retained waiter(event, listener, value, refcon, retained owner, callback); does not arm it.

waiter_arm.doc: Queues the waiter once; a value already reached also delivers through the native listener.
